name: Manastorm: the active-floor Safety Bubble shelter shows no frozen countdown (#13626)
contract: Issue #13626. On an active floor the entrance Safety Bubble 93306 stands for the whole floor (#12482) and the
active tick keeps the helper 93307 on a member inside the 8-yard entrance radius. It refreshed 93307 to its
45 s DBC duration (duration index 22) every second, so the client buff timer stuck at 44 s and never ran out.
The shelter now lasts as long as the member stays inside: its duration is permanent (-1), so no countdown is
sent, and it is still removed once the member leaves. The member activates the floor by leaving the entrance
teleport 2040, steps back in, and after 3 s the shelter's remaining duration must be -1 instead of a value
between 44000 and 45000 ms; leaving again removes it.
